_doc: The first stage: the Drifting Edge, the planetoid Orbin fell on, on Where We Started (re-cut 2026-11-25: song bars 16-23, 36-55, 92-107, 112-113). Bars: 0 the bloom (the storyboard's own tap); 1-7 calm jumps and the first jump orb (6); 8-11 the build's second half, 11 the thin riser (Helion's moment); 12-27 the drop, from its great node; 28-31 the second build, a slow portal (30); 32-43 the second drop, at speed (the rush); 44-45 the song falls quiet and the star rises. The journey (2026-11-26): the planetoid (bars 0-15), Helion's signal from the horizon at 17.6; the Shards (25.6), the Rocks (32.0), the Old Hearth (49.6, the Sleeper's throw), always following the signal.
Every bar is charted by hand (presses.json).
title: Where We Started (feat. Jex)
adds: Star-Nodes, and the ribbon: keep your finger down along it

setpieces.name: The first orb
setpieces.what: in the calm, a pickup, then a jump orb on the downbeat: tapped in mid-air, alone

setpieces.name: Helion's moment
setpieces.what: his music-box motif from the horizon, the shadow ring where he was taken; his signal lights there: 'That song... Helion?'

setpieces.name: Chase his light
setpieces.what: on the drop his signal hangs ahead of you, one place on, a light with a thread back to the horizon where he was taken; it flares on each good tap, and at 25.6 it draws you across to the Shards (a flight with an ember to tap)

setpieces.name: The light climbs
setpieces.what: the signal moves on: a flight to the Rocks (an ember on the way), and jump pads among them, long floating hops (to 44.8)

setpieces.name: The Sleeper's hand
setpieces.what: the signal slips into the dark; the world slows (48.0); the Sleeper's stone hand reaches across space from the planetoid, its palm under you, and throws you a whole bar to the Old Hearth, onto the second drop

setpieces.name: The residue chases you
setpieces.what: at speed (the fast portal), a grey tide creeps up the course behind you on the music, pushed back by every good landing; pressure only (to 70.4)
